title: Minimum Clinical Documentation Standards
text:
To be paid, the clinical notes on a claim must contain four elements: the reason for the encounter or the patient's presenting problem; the clinician's assessment, including the diagnosis being addressed; the service that was performed; and a plan or follow-up instruction.

Notes that contain all four elements and are consistent with the coded diagnosis and the billed procedure are considered sufficient. Notes are read as a whole. Sufficient documentation supports routine approval of a claim that passes all other checks. Additional documentation may be requested when any element is missing.
